_metadata.description: Operator-authorized configurable product presentation; planned validations remain unverified until observed.

requirements.title: Amended LPBS PRD and requirement registry with stable operational targets for the product-presentation model
requirements.description: The landing-page contract must define bundle scope, app scope, app visibility, single-app mode, multi-app mode, app slide limits, app ordering, detail routes, and acceptance parity between the single-app landing view and an app detail view.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. The contract names all requested single-app and multi-app behaviors and no downstream implementation evidence is treated as sufficient until the contract agrees with the request.

requirements.title: Canonical BAS app profile containing the recovered identity, narrative, feature copy, availability, installer metadata, screenshots/assets, and disabled/planned state
requirements.description: Existing Browser Automation Studio material must survive as an explicit disabled app profile without being silently deleted or diluted.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A before/after content snapshot proves that every recovered BAS field is either preserved in the profile or explicitly marked as intentionally superseded by an accepted decision; generic Aquila sections contain no BAS-only copy.

requirements.title: Canonical app and bundle manifest with duplicate identity handling for Aquila/web-console and a documented Backdrop Studio product-versus-provider decision
requirements.description: The bundle must have one canonical catalog of independently marketable app profiles with explicit public status, stable key, slug, priority, detail route, launch/download targets, narrative, and visual assets.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Public resolution never relies on database insertion order or default-enabled records; only explicitly published apps participate in public bundle mode.

requirements.title: Versioned page/block schema and coverage audit that distinguishes configured content, shared system strings, and code-owned renderer behavior
requirements.description: All user-facing marketing copy and block data must be supplied by validated presentation configuration, app profiles, plan/catalog data, or shared localization/system strings rather than hidden product-specific JSX defaults.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A static/content provenance check fails for stale BAS or Web Console marketing strings in generic public renderers and validates every configured block type before publication.

requirements.title: Server-side presentation resolver covering zero, one, and multiple public apps
requirements.description: The resolver must render a product-led page when exactly one public app is available and a bundle-led page when multiple public apps are available.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Zero-app, one-app, and two-or-more-app fixtures produce deterministic mode, scope, hero, CTA, pricing/download behavior, and app ordering without frontend first-app inference.

requirements.title: Configurable app rail/spotlight block with deterministic app order and `/apps/:appKey` detail routing
requirements.description: A multi-app bundle must show at most configured k app slides, and every app slide must link to a complete app-specific route.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A fixture with more than k public apps renders exactly k in configured order; each link resolves to its app scope and does not fall back to a generic download card.

requirements.title: App-detail presentation API and UI route with parity tests
requirements.description: App detail pages must use the same composition engine and product scope as the main page would use when that app is the only public app.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. The resolved block digest, order, app identity, hero narrative, pricing/download treatment, and CTA targets are equal between single-app mode and the corresponding detail route, except for route metadata and explicitly configured bundle navigation.

requirements.title: Order resolver and validation rules for page blocks, app slides, and scoped overrides
requirements.description: Configured block order must be authoritative; hidden renderer sorting may not move downloads, footer, or other blocks without an explicit schema constraint.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A fixture with reordered blocks produces the requested order, while invalid mandatory-placement constraints fail validation with an actionable diagnostic.

requirements.title: Validated backdrop reference fields for hero, app spotlight, and app-detail assets, plus same-origin resolution and release metadata
requirements.description: Backdrop Studio must be used as a released, surface-specific visual asset provider with reserved regions and legibility evidence, while LPBS remains responsible for HTML, copy, and page composition.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A configured reference resolves to a released asset and metadata for desktop and mobile surfaces; missing, stale, or illegible references fail or use an explicit configured fallback rather than silently rendering an empty or black frame.

requirements.title: Catalog/app spotlight block and app profile visual asset treatment for desktop and mobile
requirements.description: The catalog must communicate product value through designed visual cards, screenshots or released backdrop compositions, availability status, and a clear view-details action.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Given a fixture with public Aquila and Backdrop Studio and disabled BAS, when the public catalog renders, then it shows two distinct product presentations with clear detail actions; BAS remains available only through an authorized private preview.

requirements.title: Evidence preflight and recording assertions covering first frame, frame diversity, content landmarks, desktop/mobile dimensions, and route identity
requirements.description: Evidence capture must detect blank, black, stale, or mismatched presentation output instead of returning a superficially successful recording.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A black or blank fixture fails before handoff; a valid recording proves non-black pixels, expected Aquila/app landmarks, and the intended resolved variant and route.

requirements.title: Variant resolution diagnostics, explicit fallback metadata, and evidence labeling/guardrails
requirements.description: Configured variant failure must be visible and diagnosable; the runtime must not silently substitute the fallback page while evidence is presented as proof of the requested variant.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. The API and capture pipeline expose requested variant, resolved variant, fallback state, and reason; a capture for control cannot be labeled control when the response is fallback.

requirements.title: App capability records, evidence/constraint fields, artifact-explorer and voice-story blocks, session narrative and a distinct roadmap block, shared by single-app and detail routes
requirements.description: When Aquila is presented, the product page MUST explain local STT/TTS, AI summarization, supported artifact viewing, grouping, session search, and archive/unarchive through configured app-owned content; remote-computer and Android/iPhone control MUST remain explicitly coming soon until release evidence supports availability.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Given the same Aquila profile revision, when single-app root and detail routes render, then capability copy/status and order agree; artifact selection works with pointer and keyboard; local speech does not imply all AI processing is local; upcoming device control has no current connect/control action.

requirements.title: Validated hero-exhibit configuration and supported composition variants, with explicit app identity, order, eligibility and detail targets
requirements.description: When the bundle hero contains app exhibits, the renderer MUST use configured eligible app references and show one identifiable visual group per selected app with a matching detail link; multiple artifacts within one group MUST NOT imply additional apps.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Given two public apps and disabled BAS, when the hero renders, then exactly two identified app groups and matching detail links appear; reordering the configuration changes their order, disabled apps are excluded, invalid duplicate/unknown identities fail validation, and the hero does not increase the configured detailed-slide cap.
